title: Copper Tundra: The Navigator's Aurora Register
premise: In a magnetized polar steppe threaded by buried power rails, the navigator must synchronize the return route to the signal using a star-and-current sextant.
ending: Recover the Aurora Register and return with the verified return bearing; Polar Surveyors can finally verify the source testimony.
challenge: Survive conductive frost while evading the rail colossus without sacrificing the verified return bearing.
choice_yes: Disclose evidence and ask Polar Surveyors to witness the star-and-current sextant.
choice_no: Keep the evidence sealed until the expedition's replay record is complete.
dilemma: whether to accept an unverified coordinate
